products.name: Hair straightening and curling iron

The professional straightener with ionised titanium coating is an indispensable tool for creating perfect hairstyles. The ionisation option removes static, adds smoothness and shine, and helps eliminate frizz.
This iron is suitable for both straightening and curling, making it versatile. The styling iron has 11 heat settings.
Thanks to the ability to control the temperature settings on the electronic display, you can choose the optimal setting based on the thickness of wavy, thin or curly hair. Powered by mains voltage, with a 2.5 metre long cord. Plug type G.
